llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The Config interface is updated to replace the Validate() error method with ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error, requiring context-aware validation across the OpenTelemetry ecosystem. This change ensures all component configurations implement the new method signature.

FILES:
- opentelemetry-collector/config/config.go — Defines the updated Config interface with ValidateWithContext method
- opentelemetry-collector/component/config.go — Updates the core Config interface definition
- opentelemetry-collector/service/pipelines.go — Modifies pipeline validation calls to pass context
- opentelemetry-collector/otelcol/config.go — Updates collector config validation logic
- opentelemetry-collector/processor/batchprocessor/config.go — Implements ValidateWithContext for batch processor
- opentelemetry-collector/exporter/loggingexporter/config.go — Implements ValidateWithContext for logging exporter
- opentelemetry-collector/receiver/otlpreceiver/config.go — Implements ValidateWithContext for OTLP receiver
